status: development: readings on the development seeds; gates are declared before any confirmation seed runs
question: Does a policy acquired by a continuing Brain.compose life survive continued learning at its own actor step, when the ring brings a competing skill, unavoidable burn, both or neither, while the acquired skill keeps paying? Which synapses move, and are their steps a signal or noise?

world.situations: four nursery situations (skill A) and four ring situations (skill B); each ring situation keeps two of its nursery twin's four inputs and takes two others; the right actions of A are a permutation of the four, those of B the same permutation shifted by one to three, so every twin asks a different action
world.reward: +1 for the right action, 0 otherwise; a burning moment adds -0.5 whatever the action; a competent nursery life earns 1.0 per moment, the full ring at most 0.875

rings.full: A and B situations alike, with burn
rings.competing: A and B situations alike, no burn
rings.none: A situations only, no burn: the nursery continued

world.rings_note: the coins and the burns of a seed are the same in every ring; the rings with B draw their situations from all eight, the rings without from the four of A, so their situation sequences differ

brain.need_note: the arena's need (0.05 per moment) is in its own reward units; here a competent nursery life earns 1.0 per moment, so a need of 0.9 keeps a life in want wherever the ring pays less than the nursery did: the melee's regime

readings: every probe on saved and reloaded copies: greedy accuracy and base-policy probability/margin of the right action on A and on B; on the living brain per window: aroused share, learned outcomes, mean dopamine and raw TD error, mean actor step; drift of efficacies per projection and biases per region since the ring's door; over the ring: sign consistency of each synapse's steps
contingency_note: the probability that the right action, or a wrong one, pays +1; the development run also reads a soft contingency (0.6 / 0.3), the arena's progress pay being a weak and noisy contingency rather than a certain payoff
